kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نقتصر (form VIII)
# نَقْتَصِرُ (naqtaṣiru) /naq.ta.sˤi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
# نُقْتَصَرُ (nuqtaṣaru) /nuq.ta.sˤa.ru/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
# نَقْتَصِرَ (naqtaṣira) /naq.ta.sˤi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
# نُقْتَصَرَ (nuqtaṣara) /nuq.ta.sˤa.r
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
